newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium proposes European centre for missing children.
newsitem.headline: Belgium proposes European centre for missing children.

text.p: Belgium proposed on Thursday setting up a central European organisation to trace missing children modelled on a similar centre that exists in the United States.

"Either we will take a purely Belgian initiative...but ideally we would like to create, at a European level, a centre missing or abused children and which could work with the U.S. centre," Belgian Deputy Prime Minister Elio di Rupo told RTBF television.

The parents of Julie Lejeune, one of four young Belgian girls who died after being kidnapped by a paedophile ring, visited the U.S.'s 12-year-old National Center for Missing and Exploited Children in Arlington, Virginia, several weeks ago.
Senior Belgian police officers and magistrates will also soon fly to Arlington on a fact finding mission, RTBF reported.
